name: Notemap
tagline: Map your ideas with notes, tasks, and attachments in local files without an account.
description:
Notemap is a Swift-built Mac app for developing ideas as a mind map. It gives branches room to grow on a canvas while keeping the underlying work in local files rather than requiring a hosted account.

Start with a question or project, add and rearrange nodes, zoom into a branch to focus, then export or present the map. Notes, tasks, attachments, and cross-links help a map hold more than a short brainstorm.

## Features

- Create unlimited maps with notes, tasks, attachments, and cross-links in the free edition.
- Navigate and reorganize branches with keyboard and drag-and-drop controls.
- Import Xmind, FreeMind, OPML, Markdown, and plain text outlines.
- Use optional AI expansion with a personal provider key in Pro, along with more themes and export formats.

## Where it fits

Notemap is a good fit for visual planning and research that benefits from seeing the whole structure at once. A linear outliner may be quicker for short documents or agendas.

## Privacy and requirements

Maps are stored locally by default and no account is required. Users can place files in a cloud-synced folder themselves; AI features send selected content to the provider chosen with the user’s key. Notemap requires macOS 14 or later and supports Intel and Apple silicon.

## Pricing

Notemap is free for unlimited maps. Pro is a one-time purchase currently advertised at a $30 beta price, reduced from $60.
